t: A ready-made pocket Meshtastic radio with a screen, GPS, and a big battery.
steps: Buy the WisMesh Pocket V2 from the RAKwireless store. Pick the radio band for your country.
Screw the LoRa antenna on before you power it on.
Charge it from a 5 volt 2 amp USB-C wall adapter with the device switched off.
Install the Meshtastic app on your phone.
Turn the Pocket on and pair it with the app over Bluetooth.
Set your region in the app to match your country.
Send a test message to a friend with a second Meshtastic node.
Update the firmware later with the plain rak4631 UF2 file over USB.
meta: Open Board. From $77.97. A few stores.
